input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: Renewal term length is compliant (successive 1-year renewals, not multi-year), but the only exit from a renewal is a termination-for-convenience right requiring ninety (90) days' written notice. That exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window (and sits at the outer edge of walk-away territory), so it fails the fallback on a material term. We therefore shortened Customer's notice to thirty (30) days, matching the preferred position, while leaving Kubient's notice at ninety days to preserve service stability for us; sixty days is an acceptable fallback. No renewal price-uplift language exists (fees are revenue-share based), so the CPI/3% cap is not engaged and is noted only for completeness.

proposal.summary: Shorten Customer's post-Initial Term non-renewal/termination notice from 90 to 30 days
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms but our only exit requires ninety days' notice, so we have shortened Customer's notice period to thirty days (Kubient's stays at ninety) to match our position that renewals be easy to exit; we can accept sixty days if needed.

ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Customer may terminate this Agreement (or elect not to renew any renewal term) for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to Kubient, and Kubient may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer.
